# Harness Self-Improvement

The harness is a living system. Every agent session must leave it at least as healthy as found.

## Continuous Feedback Loop (not just session-end)

The harness improves DURING work, not just at session boundaries:

### During execution — update when discovered (don't defer to session-end):
- **New domain concept** → add to `.ai/harness/ddd-ubiquitous-language.md`
- **New project gotcha** → add to `.ai/harness/ddd-project.md`
- **Mistake or discovery** → add to `.ai/memory/lessons-learned.json`
- **Missing or stale rule** → create/update rule in `.ai/harness/rules/`
- **Structure change** → update root files via `.ai/harness/AGENTS.md`
- **Missing stack/library/style/source evidence** → update `ddd-project.md`
  Authoritative Sources, the matching stack rule `Evidence Sources`, or Source
  Debt before turning the discovery into a broad rule

### At session-end — evaluate and create:
- **Repeated multi-step operation** → create a SKILL in `.ai/harness/skills/` so any agent can do it in one shot
- **Recurring mistake pattern** → add rule to prevent it
- **Delegation gap** → propose codebase-specialized subagent in `.ai/harness/agents/`
- **Startup-context miss** → update `anchor-context-startup.md`, `ddd-project.md`, scoped lessons, or Second Brain handoffs/context so the next agent starts in the right place

**Rich feedback direction**: Harness → Agent (vertical-slice context) → Agent discovers → Harness (immediate update) → Future Agents (richer context, fewer mistakes, better skills).

## Freshness Awareness

When you touch an area, verify that harness artifacts for that area still hold:
- `lessons-learned.json`: entries scoped to your task files — still accurate? If stale, update `last_validated`
- `ddd-project.md` / `ddd-ubiquitous-language.md`: terms and structure you relied on — still match code? If not, update
- `.ai/harness/rules/`: rules you consulted — still reflect current conventions? If not, update
- `anchor-context-startup.md`: did it make the right first reads obvious? If not, fix the startup path, not only the downstream artifact.
- stack/source catalog: did external docs still apply to the local version and
  config? If not, record Source Debt or update the source applicability note.

Freshness is verified by USE, not by date-stamping. When you rely on a harness artifact and confirm it's correct, that IS the freshness verification.

## Session-End Reflection (MANDATORY)

At task completion, agents MUST invoke the **`codebase-harness-reflect`** skill to audit friction and mutate harness artifacts. Skipping reflection after non-trivial work = harness decay. The skill provides the 5-phase cognitive loop (Audit → Diagnose → Route → Execute → Prune) that converts session friction into permanent harness memory. This rule SUPERSEDES any general session-improvement instructions in root brain rules — invoke the skill, do not produce prose summaries.

**Deduplication**: If you already wrote lessons or updated DDD files during execution (per the Continuous Feedback Loop above), the reflect skill will verify and extend those writes — not duplicate them. Check existing entries before creating new ones.

**Goal**: Every session leaves the harness STRONGER. A task that required recovery this session should be one-shot for the next agent.

## Edit Contract Reminder

ALL harness edits go to `.ai/harness/` (centralized source). NEVER edit wrapper files (`.claude/rules/`, `.claude/skills/`, `.claude/agents/`, `.cursor/rules/`, `.cursor/skills/`, `.codex/skills/`, `.codex/agents/`) directly. See `governance/rules-codebase-sync.md` for the full Single-Source Edit Contract.

## Health Report Bookend

A session-end hook writes `.ai/harness/health-report.md` if present when it detects gaps (stale DDD, empty lessons-learned, missing governance rules, placeholder content). If this file exists at session start, read it and fix the reported issues before other work. The file is deleted automatically when all checks pass.

## Health Indicators

| Check | Healthy | Unhealthy |
|-------|---------|-----------|
| DDD files | >10 lines, no `{{` placeholders | Empty, stub, or unfilled template |
| Lessons-learned | >=1 entry | Empty array or missing file |
| Governance rules | All present | Any missing |
| Root files | Exist and non-empty | Missing |
